nodes.description: Endogenous CFAP410 associates tightly with NEK1 in ARPE-19 cells. The NEK1 C-terminal region spanning residues 1160-1286 is necessary and sufficient for association in cellular assays. AlphaFold predicts an interface with the CFAP410 N-terminal leucine-rich repeat region, supported by mutagenesis, but direct binding of purified proteins was not demonstrated.
